title: Lockheed P-2V7 and P3A reconnaissance aircraft
description: Two black-and-white photographs of US Navy patrol aircraft captioned "Lockheed P-2V7 and P3A reconnaissance aircraft." The top shows a dark twin-engine P-2V with wingtip tanks and the marking "SP-2" on the fuselage; the bottom shows a four-engine turboprop P-3A on a runway. Chapter 5 text (page 223) discusses training of Nationalist Chinese U-2 pilots beginning in March 1959.
